notes.title: First Dotd Retirement Announcement
notes.content:
Game announcement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/684830/view/512965890628649698?l=english]here[/url].

As you may not know, few years back Dotd: Threshold, a rework of Amiss 13 failed yet again, and it had to get retired. I have made an announcement on this on the game community hub, for game related details you can view it there.

In other news CBS series has come to fruition, and CBS: Desolation is in a much better state suited for long gameplay. I do have plans for further work, CBS: The Beginning (title pending) and an undecided possible major release later on.

I plan to keep you updated through out the work, soon you can find me on social media as well.

notes.title: CBS Eftm Build 1.5.1
notes.content:
Making a few updates today:

[h2]Minor Patch 1.5.1 Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game has an exit button now.
[*] The relief vs stuck algorithm is rebalanced, as well as dex benefit amount.
[*] The secret shop will now buy tickets for 300 creds each.
[*] Stage spawn frequencies have been rebalanced, Carriages will now spawn approximately 5% more often.
[*] Mystery box action and manual drive upgrades now function properly, and trigger properly on command.
[*] Track completion now rewards half the creds it used to. 
[/list]

notes.title: PC Build Release
notes.content:
[h1]Big Release!!!1OneVanOven[/h1]

Well, not so big, this is a literal direct conversion of the mobile game to pc. For those who had known or played it on mobile or web, there are some major changes and small tweaks to make it worth while in here.

Game will release tomorrow on 10th of June for steam (GMT +3, Istanbul time about 2 am). 

[h2]Change Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Energy bar is removed, CBS Eftm 3D can be played as long as liked, with no waiting times
[*] Default action (relief attempt) is space bar / left mouse button
[*] Stats are capped at 12 and won't be limited to a portion of stage level
[*] Type 1 madness driven creds penalty reduced.
[*] Cosmetic skins each can be bought for 16k creds
[*] Mystery box upgrade now relieves all the harmful cargo within range. (Used to relieve single targeted unstacked cargo in range.)
[*] Mystery box upgrade keybind is left ctrl
[*] Baby upgrade bonus pickup radius is increased
[*] Game UI rearranged to reflect changes
[*] Ingame ads removed
[*] Last stage occasionally spawns the Joke, which you must defeat by overpowering in speed.
[*] Relief successions are now annotated, you will know when an attempt is successful or not.
[*] Relief attempt frequency increased notably. Up to every 0.1 secs from 0.25
[/list]
